network_interface.tooltip.summary: Interfaces Simulated Sensors to kinetic Battle Networks.
network_interface.tooltip.condition1: When facing a Gimbal, Altitude or Velocity Sensor, or a Navigation Table:
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour1: _Polls_ the sensor at a rate proportional to input RPM.
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour2: _Connects_ the computer to the Battle Network and _drives_ it at the same rate.
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour3: _Connects_ the table: it shows the ship and the computer's plot, and its target goes to the computer.

ballistic_computer.tooltip.summary: The core of the fire control computer: _computes_ firing solutions for Cannon Mounts.
ballistic_computer.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
ballistic_computer.tooltip.behaviour1: _Joins_ that interface's Battle Network, reads its sensors and _sends_ firing solutions to its servos.
ballistic_computer.tooltip.condition2: When modules touch it, directly or through other modules:
ballistic_computer.tooltip.behaviour2: Each kind of module _adds a capability_. The computer's goggles list what is installed and what is missing.

differentiator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out how fast the target is moving.
differentiator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
differentiator.tooltip.behaviour1: Cannon servos _lead_ a moving target instead of lagging behind.

integrator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Keeps the solution running between readings.
integrator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
integrator.tooltip.behaviour1: _Holds_ Rangefinder solutions for 10 seconds, _compensates_ for ship speed (needs Velocity Sensors). With a _Differentiator_, the held target keeps moving.

correlator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Combines several rangefinders.
correlator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
correlator.tooltip.behaviour1: Rangefinders ranging the _same target_ are _merged_ into one more accurate fix.

fire_mission_console.tooltip.summary: The gunnery officer's station: shows the _fire mission_ and gives the _orders_.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows the guns' _firing solutions_ and trajectory parameters through Goggles.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition2: When the left knob is scrolled over:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour2: Sets a _timed fuze correction_ from -40 to +40 ticks. On _delayed impact_ and _delayed inertia_ fuzes sets the delay after impact. Scroll to turn with a 5-tick step, _Shift_-scroll for 1-tick. _Right-click_ to zero.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition3: When the middle lever is right-clicked:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition4: When the right button is right-clicked:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour4: _Fires_ every gun that has a solution and is _on target_. The others hold fire.

autocannon_control_console.tooltip.summary: The anti-aircraft gunner's station: gives the _autocannons_ their orders.
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows the autocannons' _firing solutions_ and _fire mode_ through Goggles. Autocannons always fire _direct_.
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.condition2: When the left knob is scrolled over:
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.behaviour2: Sets a _fuze correction_ from -20 to +20 ticks (1 second), added to the rounds' _timed fuzes_, 1 tick a notch. _Right-click_ to zero.
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.condition3: When the middle switch is right-clicked:
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.behaviour3: Switches between _manual_ and _automatic_ (weapons free), where autocannons fire by themselves while _on a target_.
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.condition4: While the right trigger is held with right-click:
autocannon_control_console.tooltip.behaviour4: _Fires_ every autocannon that has a solution and is _on target_. The others hold fire.

cannon_servo_input.tooltip.summary: Lays a _gun_ on the Ballistic Computer's _firing solution_. Its input half sits on the _battle network_; its output half drives the gun's _own network_.
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.condition1: When the output half is connected to a Cannon Mount or Swivel Bearing:
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.behaviour1: _Trains_ the cannon onto the solution. One servo per axis: one for _traverse_, one for _elevation_.
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.condition2: When the battle network is underpowered:
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.behaviour2: The gun _slows_ down; starved, the output network is _overstressed_ until power returns.
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.condition3: When the output half is right-clicked:
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.behaviour3: Opens the _arc limits_ dial. The gun never turns past them, and _holds fire_ on targets outside.
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.condition4: When the input half is right-clicked with an empty hand:
cannon_servo_input.tooltip.behaviour4: _Names_ the guns it lays, for console reports and map table labels. A gun's _own_ servos' name wins over a turret's.

kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.summary: Runs a _separate kinetic network_ off the input one's rotation, without joining them.
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.condition1: When the input half is powered:
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.behaviour1: The output half powers its own network at the _same RPM_. Output draw is _charged_ to the input side as stress.
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.condition2: When the input network is underpowered:
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.behaviour2: _Gears the output down_ to what it can afford, no slower than set _floor speed_. Short of even that, the output network is _overstressed_ and decoupled, and _restarts_ once input power returns.
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.condition3: When several couplers share an input network:
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.behaviour3: Input power pool is _split equally_ among them.
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.condition4: When the value box on the input half's side is used:
kinetic_network_coupler.tooltip.behaviour4: Sets the _floor speed_ for decoupling the output side.

navigation_console.tooltip.summary: Shows the ship's own _attitude_, _speed_ and _altitude_ through Goggles.
navigation_console.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
navigation_console.tooltip.behaviour1: _Shows_ each reading the network has a _sensor_ for.
navigation_console.tooltip.behaviour2: Whoever faces the controls faces the _bow_. A _Map Table_ on the network points the ship's arrow that way.

fuze_computer.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out fuze times.
fuze_computer.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
fuze_computer.tooltip.behaviour1: _Timed_ fuzes in loaded shells are _set_ to the time of flight, corrected for airburst or delay. _Delayed Impact/Inertia_ fuzes are set to post-impact delay.

rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.summary: Carries a _rangefinder_ and trains it onto targets.
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.condition1: When facing up or down and right-clicked:
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.behaviour1: _Assembles_ the attached structure. Its turning speed scales with the _network RPM_.
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.behaviour2: _Illuminates_ the eyepiece reticle. A stronger signal makes it _brighter_.
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.condition3: On a battle network with a Ballistic Computer:
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.behaviour3: A _Gimbal Sensor_ stabilizes the sight against the ship's _pitch_ and _roll_; a _Navigation Table_ with a _Redstone Magnet_, against its _yaw_.

rangefinder_lens.tooltip.summary: An objective lens for a _rangefinder_ tube. Place _two_ at the ends of the tube, looking the same way.
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.behaviour1: The _further apart_ the lenses, the more _accurate_ the range reading.
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.condition2: When cracked by blast or a hit:
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.behaviour2: Range readings become _far less accurate_. Right-click the lens with a _Glass Pane_ to repair it.

map_table.tooltip.summary: A plotting table for _maps_. Joins with neighboring tables into a square.
map_table.tooltip.condition1: When right-clicked with a Filled Map:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour1: _Lays_ the map on that part of the table. Maps must share the same zoom and fit together _like the land_, north up.
map_table.tooltip.condition2: When right-clicked with an empty hand:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour2: _Opens_ the table, showing all its maps stitched together.
map_table.tooltip.condition3: When a Battle Network Interface faces it:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour3: _Shows_ the ship's position and _sends_ the marked target to the _Ballistic Computer_.

rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.summary: The operator's station on a _rangefinder_ tube. _Bolts_ onto the back of the tube, _centered_ between the lenses.
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.condition1: When right-clicked on an assembled tube:
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.behaviour1: _Seats_ the player and starts aiming through the _sight_. The tube turns to _follow_ the look.
